\documentclass{article}
\title{Improved Sequence Encoder}
\date{2021}
\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
We revisit the baseline encoder and improve its optimization schedule.
\end{abstract}

\section{Method}
We keep the layer structure of the baseline unchanged, using 6 layers.

\section{Experiments}
We train with a learning rate of 0.0003 for the base model, which we find
converges faster than prior work. We keep a dropout rate of 0.1 to remain
comparable. Our runs use a batch size of 256 sequences.

\end{document}
